The graduate was arrested and held in custody overnight before the matter was resolved. The graduate suffered severe emotional distress at the publicity she received in the local newspapers and the humiliation she suffered for being arrested and held in police custody. If the graduate asserts a claim against the bar-review company based on infliction of emotional distress, will she prevail?
